readout_other: Morris water maze; novel object recognition; DTI (FA, MD, AD, RD); Golgi, Luxol fast blue, TUNEL, TEM, GFAP/IBA1/NeuN immunofluorescence; c-Fos for targeting
direction_notes: LIFUS improved water maze and novel object recognition performance in cisplatin-treated rats, raised dendritic spine density and reduced myelin loss, apoptosis and glial markers; c-Fos expression at the target was used as evidence of activation.
safety_notes: H&E staining of the targeted hippocampal region showed no abnormalities in any group.
